review_locator: PMCID:PMC4884457, Interleukin-34 and its receptor CSF-1R; PMCID:PMC7062519, Emerging roles of IL-34 in health and disease
primary_title: Interleukin-34 selectively enhances the neuroprotective effects of microglia to attenuate oligomeric amyloid-beta neurotoxicity
decision_basis: The review-guided primary shows IL-34 increases insulin-degrading enzyme expression in primary microglia and in an APP/PS1 model, accompanying enhanced soluble oligomeric amyloid-beta clearance.
limitations_preserved: Preserve CSF1R-dependent microglial and APP/PS1 neurodegeneration context; IDE is a measured output bridge and does not establish direct IL-34-to-IDE promoter binding or SCI relevance.
